Hi Sophie — great to meet today, appreciate the clear goals.

Short answers up front:
- Quickstart: see attached redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf and the hosted quickstart link below (curl + Python snippets).
- Rate limits: default Hosted API rate limits start at 60 requests/minute per API key with 4 concurrent streaming connections; we can raise limits for evaluations (subject to quota & billing). Burst handling is supported up to ~2x for short periods; sustained higher QPS should move to Dedicated.
- Token limits: single request/response combined soft limit is 32k tokens for the models we demoed; please share typical prompt + expected response sizes so we can help estimate cost.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching is available on Hosted for eligible models — it reduces token usage for repeated prefixes and is automatically applied in our runtime when cacheable.

Attachments: redwood-quickstart-guide.pdf (quick curl, SDK, and sample payloads).
Quick links:
- Quickstart: https://docs.redwood.inference/quickstart/hosted-api

- HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/ACME-2026-045
